item.title: 📹 Footage from liberated Konstantinovka, filmed by fighters of the 84th Motorised Rifle Division and the 72nd Separate Motorised Rifle Brigade (Yuzhnaya Group of Forces).
item.description: 📹 Footage from liberated Konstantinovka, filmed by fighters of the 84th Motorised Rifle Division and the 72nd Separate Motorised Rifle Brigade (Yuzhnaya Group of Forces). Troops in designated sectors of the city are inspecting buildings on the territory of industrial enterprises, residential yards, and roads in their assigned sectors of the city for unexploded ordnance or signs of remote mining, which is still being carried out by long-range heavy AFU drones. ➡️ Consolidation units are paying particular attention to industrial areas: the city's metallurgical plant, monitoring the situation in the treelines of Yubileyny Park, near the Iosif Stalin tank monument, and in the area of one of Konstantinovka's thoroughfares – Oleksa Tykhy Avenue, next to the Orthodox church and the railway station. 🎮 Reconnaissance drone operators are maintaining 24/7 surveillance over key facilities and city streets , tracking all movements of consolidation units and providing them with real-time situational updates within their operational areas. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29936

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
❗️
From 3 to 9 of October, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out one mass and seven group strikes,
which hit defence industry enterprises, logistics and telecommunication centres, energy and transport infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the AFU, military airfields, production and storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles, ammunition depots of fuel and military-technical equipment, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries.
▪️
In addition, the strikes disabled a number of Ukrainian port infrastructure facilities used for receiving, storing, and distributing military cargo, as well as fuel and lubricants destined for the AFU.
💥
During the week, 14 dry cargo ships and one tanker engaged in supplying Western weapons, military hardware, fuel, and materiel intended to support the AFU were hit.
➡️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces continued to tighten the encirclement
of enemy's formations in the north-east of Kharkov region and expand the external control zone.
🚩
Last week, as a result of resolute actions, the settlement of Annopolye (Kharkov region) was taken under control.
All the enemy's attempts to break through the encirclement were thwarted.
▪️
Over the past week, the enemy has lost more than 275 militants, three armoured fighting vehicles, two motor vehicles, and three UGVs.
▪️
In total, 414 sq km of territory and 20 settlements have been liberated since the beginning of the AFU group's encirclement in the north-east of Kharkov region. More than 1,360 troops, 35 armoured fighting vehicles, 21 motor vehicles, 18 ATVs, and 34 UGVs have been neutralised.
🚩
Moreover, Russian troops established control over Novaya Kazachya (Kharkov region) and yesterday took under control Kiyanitsa (Sumy region).
💥
In Sumy and Kharkov regions, strikes were delivered
at manpower and hardware of five mechanised brigades, two motorised infantry brigades, two airmobile brigades, one unmanned system brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, three territorial defence brigades, and one national guard brigade.
▪️
Over the past week, in the Sever Group's area of responsibility, the enemy lost more than 1,850 troops, 15 armoured fighting vehicles, 134 motor vehicles, six field artillery guns, and eight electronic warfare and counter-fire radars.
📍
During the week, the Zapad Group of Forces have taken more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's units inflicted losses on formations of four mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades.
▪️
The AFU losses in this direction amounted to more than 1,565 troops, 13 armoured fighting vehicles, 93 motor vehicles, nine field artillery guns, one U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS launcher, and five electronic warfare stations.
📍
Last week, the Yuzhnaya Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one mountain assault brigade, two airmobile brigades of the AFU, one marine brigade, and two territorial defence brigades.
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 1,215 troops, ten armoured fighting vehicles, 162 motor vehicles, nine field artillery guns, and three electronic and counter-fire radars in the Yuzhnaya Group's area of responsibility.
👉

🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

as of 3–9 October 2026

📍
During the week, the Tsentr Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
The losses were inflicted on formations of five mechanised brigades, one assault brigade, one jaeger brigade, one airborne brigade, one unmanned systems regiment of the AFU, two marine brigades, two national guard brigades, and the Azov Special Operations Brigade.
⏩
In Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic), units of the 51st Army are developing an pincer movement
in the west and east of the city. All the enemy's attempts to break through the encirclement and perform personnel rotation were thwarted.
▪️
Since the beginning of the enemy's encirclement in Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic), more than 520 militants, one armoured fighting vehicle, and six pickup trucks have been neutralised.
▪️
In total, more than 3,415 troops, 23 armoured fighting vehicles, 69 motor vehicles, six field artillery guns, and 13 electronic warfare stations have been neutralised in the Tsentr Group's area of responsibility.
🚩
Over the past week, units of the Vostok Group of Forces have continued to advance to the depths of the enemy's defence, liberated Samoylovka and Golubkovo (Zaporozhye region).
💥
The Russian elements inflicted losses
on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one assault brigade, three air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the AFU, and one marine brigade.
▪️
The enemy lost in this direction over 1,845 troops, 14 armoured fighting vehicles, 67 motor vehicles, and seven field artillery guns.
📍
Last week, the Dnepr Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
The Group's units hit manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades and one mountain assault brigade of the AFU.
▪️
Up to 245 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 127 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and seven electronic warfare and counter-fire stations were neutralised.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
31 guided aerial bombs, nine HIMARS MLRS projectiles, 17 Flamingo long-range cruise missiles, and 7,389 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊

item.title: 💥 Unexpected speed of Molniya: the Sever Group's drone operators destroyed sheltered AFU manpower in Sumy region.
item.description: 💥 Unexpected speed of Molniya: the Sever Group's drone operators destroyed sheltered AFU manpower in Sumy region. 💬 After receiving the coordinates, it took literally two minutes to hit the target. The commander of an unmanned systems company with the call sign 'Pers', described his unit's lightning-fast response: 'We received the coordinates of the enemy's manpower shelter. I checked the map, chose the crew able to carry out the task as fast as possible. I assigned the target. Two minutes to readiness. The target was hit.' 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
